description.en: Specifies whether to disable logon with a weak password.
The list of password complexity rules.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-password-complexity-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-min-length 10 --password-complexity-rules PasswordCheckType=inclusion_upper_case --disabled-weak-password-login true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPasswordComplexityConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --DisabledWeakPasswordLogin true --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordMinLength 10 --PasswordComplexityRules.1.PasswordCheckType inclusion_upper_case --method POST --force
